tooltip.mapmipmapmod.map_mipmap_levels:
Controls the levels of mipmaps to be used for maps.
"0" disables the mipmaps for maps (Vanilla).
"8" maxes out the levels (1 pixel texture at minimum resolution)
"Auto" selects the same levels as in the Minecraft config.
tooltip.mapmipmapmod.atlas_size:
The maximum maps for the atlases images.
Lower values might not bring the best performance, whereas higher values might cause lag and render instability.
"1" Disables atlases (Vanilla).
"Auto" selects an adequate size depending on the selected mipmap levels.
tooltip.mapmipmapmod.map_updates_only_un: Only enables updates for unlocked maps. locked maps won't try to update their contents. Recommended option.
tooltip.mapmipmapmod.map_updates_all: Uses default vanilla behaviour. Might cause lag and render instability.
tooltip.mapmipmapmod.map_updates_none: Disables updates for locked and unlocked maps. This option is not recommended if the map contents are changing.
tooltip.mapmipmapmod.depth_bias:
Controls the level of depth where the maps should be rendered over other textures.
This feature helps with Z-fighting when maps are in item frames and viewed from extreme distances.
"0" No depth bias (Vanilla).
"8" Maxes out the bias (May cause visual layering).
tooltip.mapmipmapmod.invisible_frames_on: Turns item frames invisible if there are maps displayed in them. Useful for transparent maps.
tooltip.mapmipmapmod.invisible_frames_al: Turns all item frames invisible. Their contents are displayed normally.
